name: GLB Archaeology
steps: parse GLB > connected islands > metrics > family fingerprints > symmetry candidates > explode vectors
acceptance_gates: source hash recorded; component counts deterministic; source unmodified

name: Exploded Review
steps: split connected islands > arrange by explode mode > inspect families/topology/spatial cells > record decisions
acceptance_gates: all components addressable; source pose recoverable; no authored geometry mutation
notes: Presentation organ for phone and browser review.

name: Canonicalize Repeated Family
output_contract: canonical clean part plus placement transforms
steps: rank family > select representative > retopo/rebuild > fit anchors > instance placements > add bounded irregularity
acceptance_gates: representative approval; transform parity; no accidental scale drift
notes: Locomotion and repeated armor hardware are prime targets.

name: Manufactured Part Rebuild
steps: measure silhouette > establish datum planes > rebuild closed solids > bevel/support edges > validate normals/manifold
acceptance_gates: silhouette gate; manifold gate; interface gate; triangle budget
notes: Do not sculpt cleanup over broken generated topology when a manufactured rebuild is cheaper.

name: Bounded Meshy Component Regeneration
input_contract: isolated reference plus explicit gene subset
steps: prepare reference > constrain prompt to semantic role and interfaces > generate variants > archaeology pass > compare > promote/reject
acceptance_gates: interface bounds; silhouette match; topology diagnostics; ledger outcome
notes: Use generation where organic complexity carries value; do not use it as a universal screwdriver.

name: PBR Texture Pass
input_contract: approved geometry plus material roles and genes
output_contract: PBR texture set and material assignments
steps: assign domains > generate/paint base > roughness/normal/metallic > wear/grime/tissue layers > inspect under neutral light
acceptance_gates: material-role separation; UV validity; no baked lighting; mobile memory budget
notes: Geometry and phenotype texture axes remain independently inspectable.

name: Variant Compiler
steps: resolve defaults > apply variant genes > group part treatments > emit action queues > launch downstream lanes
acceptance_gates: all referenced genes exist; no silent decision overrides; plan diffable
notes: Declarative bridge from spreadsheet-shaped judgment to execution.

name: Non-destructive Damage Overlay
input_contract: intact canonical assembly plus damage genes
steps: choose damage regions > substitute/bend/detach plates > add scars/debris > texture wear > retain intact parent
acceptance_gates: parent remains reconstructable; damage readable; attachment logic explicit
notes: Avoid making wounded state the canonical base mesh.
